temporal_state_chain.observed: Elizabeth has been unusually curt over the past few days; when Keith asks if he upset her, she says she is not upset with him and is dealing with personal stuff.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Elizabeth might be upset with him, possibly because of a misunderstanding or an unknowing mistake.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Elizabeth's denial and explanation shift his interpretation from personal grievance to her own personal stress.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Elizabeth is not upset with him; her curtness is due to personal stress.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To be supportive and find out if she wants to talk or needs help.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Elizabeth accepts Keith's offer of support and a coffee break, saying it is kind and sounds good.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Elizabeth is dealing with personal stress and is not upset with him; she may need support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; her acceptance shows she is receptive to his support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Elizabeth is open to his support, and a coffee break could help her.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To offer a supportive listening ear during the coffee break and help her through her stress.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Over coffee, Elizabeth shares more about her stresses, which seem severe; when Keith suggests professional help, she says she has thought about it but is hesitant.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Elizabeth is under personal stress and is receptive to friendly support; Keith may be able to help as a supportive friend.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; learning the severity of her stress and her hesitation, he believes professional help might benefit her but worries about offending her.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Elizabeth may need professional help, but she is hesitant; he must be careful not to offend or pressure her.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To gently support her in considering professional help without pushing, while remaining supportive.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After the professional-help suggestion, Elizabeth becomes slightly withdrawn; when Keith apologizes and reassures her, she says he did not overstep, appreciates his concern, but says it is a lot to think about.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: His suggestion may have embarrassed Elizabeth, and he regrets possibly overstepping.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; her reassurance reduces his worry: she did not feel he overstepped, though the topic is still heavy for her.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Elizabeth appreciates his concern and is not offended, but she needs time to process; he should be careful and supportive.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Regretful, then reassured but still cautious.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To reassure her of his support without pressing the professional-help issue.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Elizabeth seems more open and appreciative of Keith's concern; she says his support means a lot and she feels better knowing she has it.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Elizabeth appreciates his concern but may need time; Keith wants to maintain a supportive relationship.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; her openness confirms she values his support and feels more comfortable around him.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Elizabeth values his support and feels better because of it; their supportive relationship is positive.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To maintain the supportive relationship and continue being available for chats or breaks.
